scenario_narratives.base: Restart delivers but below the FID deck. Long-run SC6 CIF US$1,300/t (reserve-case price US$1,330; FID case US$1,500) at AUD/USD 0.68 = ~A$1,910/t, escalating 2%/yr from FY30. Sales 60kt in FY27 (Grants open pit only, first shipment December quarter, realised ~US$1,100/t in a weak market, plus the final 25kt fines sale), 130kt in FY28 (BP33 development ore from mid-CY27), 200kt from FY29 (93% of 214ktpa nameplate -- a haircut for the recovery shortfall of the 2023-24 campaign). Unit cost A$875/t (15% above the study's A$762/t) plus ~16% of revenue for royalties, freight and corporate gives a 38% steady-state EBITDA margin against the study's 48% at US$1,500. Restart capital A$208m: ~A$22m spent in FY26, A$140m in FY27 and ~A$45m in FY28, then ~11% of revenue for underground sustaining development and the later Carlton/Grants underground sources. A$372m of gross tax losses shelter EBIT to FY32, then 30%. Terminal capped at 3x FY41 FCF: 15.6Mt of reserves fund ~13 years at 1.2Mtpa and the cap stands for partial conversion of the 48.2Mt resource, not a perpetuity.
scenario_narratives.bear: The 2024 story repeats in slow motion: oversupply holds SC6 at ~US$1,000/t (A$1,470/t), DMS recoveries again miss and sales plateau at 175ktpa, and unit costs run 25% over study (A$950/t). EBITDA margin settles near 19.5%, sustaining capital is cut to the minimum (14% of revenue) and the operation roughly covers itself -- about A$13m/yr of FCF against ~A$215m of restart-and-ramp cash burn in FY27-28. Tax losses are never exhausted inside the reserve life. Terminal capped at 1x. Equity is left as residual cash net of the Nebari loan and the convertible notes at face: approximately nil. In practice the Board would suspend again, as it did in 2024, and the senior secured lender would rank ahead.
scenario_narratives.bull: The deficit view is right and Finniss performs to study: SC6 US$1,700/t long-run (A$2,500/t; the 30 June 2026 spot was ~US$2,200), 214ktpa nameplate from FY29 with the reflux classifier lifting global recovery to 78%, unit cost A$762/t as studied, EBITDA margin 53.5%. FY27 65kt at US$1,400, FY28 150kt at US$1,600. Tax losses are used up in FY30. Terminal capped at 5x for resource conversion and Blackbeard feed extending life beyond 20 years. NOTE: in this scenario the US$70m notes convert at A$0.252 (~410m shares); carrying them as debt overstates this scenario by ~A$0.02/share.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Core Lithium is valued as what it now is: a funded, restarting single-asset mine whose worth is the discounted Finniss cash-flow stream under three spodumene-price and execution paths, plus pro-forma cash, less the notes, the Nebari loan and closure provisions. The spread between scenarios is the finding -- approximately nil in the bear, roughly double the base in the bull -- because the equity is a geared option on the lithium price. Trailing financials are ignored for margins and used only for the balance sheet and tax losses.
key_risks_to_valuation: Spodumene price: each US$100/t on the long-run deck moves steady-state revenue ~A$29m/yr and base value by roughly A$0.03-0.04/share
Recovery and ramp-up: the 2023-24 campaign missed plan; base assumes 93% of nameplate, bear 82%
BP33 underground schedule and cost (A$274m Develop Global contract; development ore mid-CY27, steady state mid-CY28)
Further dilution: convertible notes at A$0.252 (~410m shares) and the company's record of equity raises in every downturn
AUD/USD: revenue is USD, costs AUD; deck uses 0.68 against the study's 0.70
Mine life: reserves cover ~13 years at 1.2Mtpa; the 20-year plan relies on converting resources
Near-term price is an estimate -- no realised price for new production has been reported yet

inputs.share_count_basis: 3,236.8m ordinary shares (FY26 AR top-20 statement) + 31.2m performance rights (32.9m less 1.7m lapsed after year end) + 6.5m options struck at A$0.224. Held flat. The US$70m convertible notes (conversion price A$0.252, ~410m shares at AUD/USD 0.6774) are carried as DEBT at face, not as shares: base and bear values sit below the conversion price, so in 75% of the weight the notes are a claim to be repaid. The bull value is overstated by ~A$0.02/share on this basis (see bull narrative).
inputs.net_debt_note: PRO FORMA on the 30 June 2026 balance sheet. Cash: 181.8 reported + 62.2 tranche-2 convertible notes + 35.2 Nebari tranche-1 drawdown (both received August 2026) - 3.75 Bynoe tenement acquisition (July 2026) = 275.5. Debt: convertible notes US$70m face = 103.3 at AUD/USD 0.6774; Nebari senior secured US$25m = 36.9; lease liabilities 4.8. The balance-sheet carrying value of the tranche-1 notes (29.1) is a hybrid-instrument measure, not the claim. Cross-check: the September quarterly reported cash of 199.7 at 30 September 2026, i.e. ~72 of first-quarter burn excluding Bynoe, consistent with the year-1 flows below. Undrawn: Nebari tranche 2, US$25m.
inputs.sbc_treatment: SBC is charged INSIDE ebitda_margin_path (each margin is the operating margin in the narrative less SBC of 1.5%/0.8%/0.5% of revenue in base, 1.7/1.0/0.6 bear, 1.2/0.6/0.4 bull), and sbc_pct_path is held at an explicit 0. Reason: at a sub-A$1 share price the house and street values differ by less than one cent, and the engine divides by their two-decimal difference. The house value is unchanged by this; the street memo equals house and band_position is null.
inputs.sbc_source: FY2026 annual report cash-flow reconciliation, share-based payment expense A$1,011k (CXO.AX_Annual_FY2026.txt:4829); no equity-award withholding taxes disclosed
inputs.wacc_rationale: 10% nominal AUD, the same in all three scenarios. Australian 10-year ~4.4% + 6% ERP x beta ~1.5 for a single-asset lithium producer gives a cost of equity near 13%; the capital structure now carries ~A$140m of 8-9% notes and senior debt. Commodity-price and ramp-up risk are charged in the scenario flows and weights, not in a WACC premium (risk charged once). With 2% nominal escalation this is ~8% real, the rate of the company's own NPV8.
inputs.lease_treatment: Treatment A: lease liabilities (A$4.8m) in net debt, no lease charge in the flows. Immaterial.
inputs.notes: MODEL: mine-plan owner-FCF DCF run through the component engine as a finite-life project NPV. Routed as a cyclical non-US operating company (owner-fcf.md + adaptations), NOT as a distressed shell and NOT off trailing financials: FID was taken 18 March 2026, the restart is funded, first concentrate was produced September 2026, so the value is the forward Finniss cash-flow stream. FY2016-FY2026 history is exploration, one aborted production campaign and care-and-maintenance and carries no information about steady-state margins; every driver is built from the restart study (214ktpa SC6-eq nameplate, A$762/t unit cost, A$208m restart capital, 48% EBITDA margin and A$837m post-tax NPV8 at US$1,500/t) with haircuts, on a price x volume deck stated in each scenario narrative. Growth rates are mechanical: they reproduce the revenue deck from the A$17.8m FY26 stockpile-sale base and are not growth judgments. 15-year horizon (FY27-FY41) with a low terminal cap (1x/3x/5x) because a mine is a depleting asset. CALIBRATION: base EV of roughly A$0.4bn against the company's A$837m post-tax NPV8 -- the gap is the price deck (US$1,300 vs US$1,500), 7% lower volume, 15% higher unit cost and the one-year-later start. PRICE DECK CAVEAT: no live spodumene quote was available; the last filed spot is ~US$2,200/t CIF at 30 June 2026, and lithium equities have since roughly halved (peer share prices August to November 2026), so near-term realised prices are set below the long-run deck. Replace the FY27 price when the December-quarter report prints a realised figure. reported_fcf is the Metrics CSV figure (OCF -21.1 less PP&E/exploration 8.8); it excludes A$15.2m of mine development spend, so true FY26 cash burn before financing was ~A$45m. Buybacks nil; the company is a serial issuer (shares up 12x since 2016, +51% in FY26) and a further raise is the main unmodelled risk in the bear path. House and street bases coincide to the cent (SBC ~0.5% of steady-state revenue, ~A$2m/yr); see sbc_treatment.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 3x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear 25% (above the 15% default): single asset, a first production campaign that failed on price and recovery within 18 months, senior secured debt for the first time, and lithium equities halving since August 2026 with forecasters split on a glut through 2027. Base 50%: the restart is funded, contracted and on schedule, and the deck sits at the reserve-case price. Bull 25% (below the 35% default): it needs both a sustained price above the FID deck and study-level recoveries the plant has not yet demonstrated.
probability_weighted.band_note: House and street coincide (SBC immaterial): the band collapsed, so band_position is null rather than a degenerate 0.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
sanity_check.checks_replaced: model is risked_npv: no multiples rule applies; the historical table is reported for context only
